questions.topic: Why a demographic shock reorganises an economy
questions.learningObjective: Explain why a demographic shock reorganises an economy

stimulus.body: Source note: Why a demographic shock reorganises an economy. A sudden population fall raises the price of labour, lowers pressure on land, and pushes owners toward new uses, reorganising production and wages together.

questions.stem: Consulting the source note, explain why a demographic shock reorganises an economy.

answer.exemplar: A sudden population fall raises the price of labour, lowers pressure on land, and pushes owners toward new uses, reorganising production and wages together.

questions.explanation: A demographic shock raises labour's price and frees land, reorganising production. The error is to assume population loss automatically raises total output.
